17 Athletes Named for Arjuna Awards; No Khel Ratna Announced

The Sports Ministry announced the National Sports Awards for 2025, naming 17 athletes for the Arjuna Award. Notably, no athlete was selected for the prestigious Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award this year. The awards recognize outstanding performances in various sports. A committee, chaired by former Supreme Court judge Arun Mishra, made the selections.
